messages:
Aisha K.: Quick shoutout thread — massive thanks to Tom B. for sprinting to the office at 7:45 to help set up the customer demo AV when the projector decided to take a sick day. Also grabbed emergency bagels. Lifesaver :raised_hands: :baguette_bread:
Tom B.: It was the HDMI cable and a sticky oomph on the projector fan. Happy to help! Also the bagels were from that cupboard of miracles :bread:
Riley P.: shoutout for Janet too — coordinated access with facilities and kept the client calm on the call while we MacGyvered it :sparkles:
Janet O.: teamwork! honestly everyone who jumped in deserves a donut. Can we add this to the wins board and drop it in retro? :doughnut:
Aisha K.: vote: reward idea react with :star: for bagels, :coffee: for coffee vouchers, :trophy: for gift card. Poll open 48h
OpsBot: Poll opened by Aisha K. react to vote. Poll will close in 48 hours.
Tom B.: :coffee: (I will split my coffee voucher with Riley)
Riley P.: :star: (bagels please)
Janet O.: :trophy: (gift card for the facilities team rep?)
Aisha K.: Adding notes to demo log and kudos channel. Seriously thanks all — small emergencies, big teamwork :sparkling_heart:
Tom B.: Dibs on the hole-in-one bagel. Also happy to run a 15-min "AV survival" session if folks want to learn quick fixes.
